simple.summary: דָּחָה (dâchâh) means to push down First listed occurrence: Isa 11 12.

definitions.usage: chase, drive away (on), overthrow, outcast, × sore, thrust, totter.
definitions.full: H1760. dachah דָּחָה verb push, thrust (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic דְּחָא דְּחִי, , ; cf also Arabic , spread, extend , also throw, propel ) — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular suffix דְּחִיתַנִי Psa 118:13 ; Infinitive construct לִדְחוֺת 140:5 ; absolute דָּחֹה 118:13 ; Participle active דֹּחֶה 35:5 (read ᵐ5 דֹּחָם De Che); passive feminine הַדְּחוּיָה 62:4 ; — push , דָחָה דָּחֹה push violently figurative with accusative 118:13 followed by clause of purpose לִנְמֹּל , compare פעמי לִדְחוֺת 140:5 (Che trip up my feet ), & 35:5 (transpose דחה with רדפם 35:6 and read ᵐ5 דֹּחָם ; compare וַחֲלַקְלַקֹּת חשׁך יְהִידֿרכם v a , and Jer 23:12 ); pushed in (Che), in simile, passive participle, said of גָּדֵר wall Psa 62:4 (|| נטוי קיר ). Niph`al Imperfect יִדָּחֶה Prov 14:32 ; (3masculine plural יִדַּ֫חוּ Jer 23:12 is from דחח , if rightly pointed; נִדְחֵי Isa 11:12 ; 56:8 ; Psa 147:2 , see below נדח ); — be thrust or cast down , figurative of wicked Prov 14:32 , compare Psa 35:6 above Pu`al Perfect 3 plural דֹּחוּ Psalm 36:13 they are thrust down (|| נפלו & קום יכלו לא ). [ דָּחַח ] verb only Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine plural יִדַּ֫חוּ (Kö i. 377 ) Jer 23:12 they shall be thrust down , figurative, of wicked; read perhaps יִדָּח֫וּ , from דחה q. v. דחן (√ of following; perhaps compare Arabic smoke arose , hence become dusky, dingy, inclining to black ).
